caption: The drawing depicts a decorative handbag with a metallic silver handle and frame. The body of the bag is adorned with a colorful floral pattern featuring large leaves and flowers in shades of green, pink, blue, yellow, red, and white, outlined in black. The background in the upper portion of the bag is a pale pinkish beige, while the lower section has a dark brown background with additional floral designs. The bottom edge of the handbag is embellished with a fringe made of long, thin, silver-colored strands. The composition centers the bag on a plain, off-white background with slight discoloration and horizontal crease marks visible across the middle.
title: Bag
